notes: Single main article, no supplementary file. All H2 uptake values are the authors' own gravimetric (Hiden IGA-001, buoyancy-corrected) measurements at 77 K, 1 and 20 bar, on seven sucrose-derived carbons (UCs-60 to UCs-100, UCs-90-2, Cs-90). BET area reported for every carbon in Table 1, N2 at 77 K. is_retracted false in record.json and no retraction notice in text. Paper is original research (not a review) and does not state that its H2 values were published before. Carbon: majority-carbon templated carbons, zeolite removed by HF/HCl. Table 1 and Fig. 6 checked on page images.
